description: Snaps the y-value of a feature placement pos to the floor or the ceiling within the provided vertical_search_range. The placement biome is preserved. If the snap position goes outside of the placement biome, placement will fail.

tokens.text: adjusts Y position to snap features to floor or ceiling

fields.title: Embed In Surface
fields.description: If true, the snapped feature is embedded into the located surface block instead of being placed on top of it.

example.path: Scattering multiple different plants around a monument

fields.title: Identifier
fields.description: The name of this feature in the form 'namespace_name:feature_name'. 'feature_name' must match the filename.

fields.title: Search Range
fields.description: Range to search for a valid snapping position for the feature.

fields.title: Surface
fields.description: Defines the surface that the y-value of the placement position will be snapped to. Valid values: 'ceiling', 'floor', 'random_horizontal' and `wall`

fields.title: Allow Air Placement
fields.description: Determines whether the feature can snap through air blocks. Defaults to true.

fields.title: Allow Non Air Placement
fields.description: Determines whether the feature can snap through non air blocks. Defaults to false, is only used if the snap is started in a block that is not water or air.

fields.title: Allow Underwater Placement
fields.description: Determines whether the feature can snap through water blocks. Defaults to false.

fields.title: Allowed Surface Blocks
fields.description: A list of blocks that the feature is permitted to snap to. Leaving this empty results in the feature snapping to blocks that can provide support for the given face (up/down/horizontal)

fields.title: Embed In Surface
fields.description: Determines whether the placed feature should be embedded in the found surface.
